info.title: Ephyra Judge API
info.description: Online judge API. Authentication is a session cookie plus a CSRF header, both same-origin: fetch /api/auth/csrf, send the readable ephyra_csrf cookie back as X-CSRF-Token on every unsafe method. Fields are omitted rather than nulled when the caller is not allowed to see them, so a client must branch on presence.

servers.description: Same origin. The frontend proxies /api to the backend, so no CORS is involved.
